description: [compact alias of get_node_properties] Returns all properties of a specific node in a scene. Use to inspect current values before modifying. Returns property names, values, and types.

includeDefaults.description: If true, includes properties with default values. If false (default), only modified properties.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to project directory containing project.godot. Use the same path across all tool calls in a workflow.

scenePath.description: Path to .tscn file relative to project (e.g., "scenes/Player.tscn")

name: scene-node-properties
